## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix failure-report matching so a `./` prefix cannot silently exclude a requested failed test from a rerun.

## Changes

The pull request adds a selector for failed paths in runner reports, refactors cached selection, and adds tests for all three selectors.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

- app/selection.py:20 — correctness — Match failure-report paths with a `./` prefix — A report containing `./tests/test_x.py` returns an empty selection when `requested` contains `tests/test_x.py`. The failure selector compares the raw path, while both existing selectors strip `./` before matching. — Users rerunning failures can skip a requested test when the runner reports it with a `./` prefix. — Fix: Match on `normalize(path)` while returning the original path, and extend `test_failure_report_selection`.
